title: Global Case Competition at Harvard judging protocol

criteria.name: Video pitch
criteria.official_purpose: Assess clarity, synthesis, and presentation quality.

criteria.name: Team performance during the finale with the Judge panel

scoring.winner_selection: Judges select the winners taking into consideration the case solution deck, video pitch, and team performance during the finale with the Judge panel.
scoring.note: No total or relative weighting is published; none is inferred.

sources.title: GCCH 2026
sources.evidence: Official competition structure and the three components considered by judges.

sources.title: GCCH 2024/25
sources.evidence: Official edition page states that judges use the case solution, video pitch, and panel questions.

provenance.unsupported_gap: No public official point rubric was found. Historical case packets for 2018-2023 publish recommended solution guidelines and submission rules, not judging weights; they are not converted into grading criteria.
